items.q: Umushinga usanzwe umara igihe kingana iki?
items.a: Imishinga myinshi imara hagati y'ibyumweru 6 na 16 bitewe n'ubunini bwayo, kuva ku iperereza kugeza ku itangizwa.
Yego — gahunda n'uburyo bwacu byifashisha kuva ku bicuruzwa bito kugeza kuri sisitemu z'ibigo binini.
Vue, React, Node.js, Python, ibikoresho bya cloud n'ibikoresho bigezweho bya telefone.

items.q: Mushobora gutanga ubufasha nyuma yo gutangiza?
items.a: Yego rwose. Dutanga ubufasha buhoraho, gukurikirana n'iterambere ry'ibiranga bishya.
Saba ikiganiro cy'iperereza kandi tuzasobanura umushinga wawe mu minsi, ntabwo ari ibyumweru.
